# Select (`select`)

Custom dropdown with search, groups and icons.

Group: Text inputs. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/text-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createSelect` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/select.d.ts`): `.mh-input.mh-select`: a styled native `<select>` with a chevron, inside a `.mh-field`. The platform draws the list, so it works with every keyboard, screen reader and touch picker.

```ts
export function createSelect(options: SelectOptions): SelectHandle;

export interface SelectOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  /** Options, or groups of options (`<optgroup>`). */
  options: readonly SelectItem[];
  value?: string;
  /** A first, empty choice shown until one is picked. */
  placeholder?: string;
  name?: string;
  helper?: string;
  error?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  size?: InputSize;
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  onChange?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface SelectHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  select: HTMLSelectElement;
  field: FieldHandle | null;
  getValue(): string;
  setValue(value: string): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

export type SelectItem = SelectOption | SelectOptionGroup;

export interface FieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  label: HTMLLabelElement | HTMLSpanElement;
  /** The described element (input, select, textarea or the control). */
  target: HTMLElement;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  /** Updates the counter: `3 / 40` with a max, `3` without. */
  setCount(count: number, max?: number): void;
  /** Dims the label and messages (the control disables itself). */
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createSelect } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const room = createSelect({
  label: 'Room',
  placeholder: 'Choose a room',
  options: [
    { value: 'living', label: 'Living room' },
    { value: 'kitchen', label: 'Kitchen' },
    { value: 'bedroom', label: 'Bedroom' },
    { value: 'garage', label: 'Garage', disabled: true },
  ],
  onChange: (value) => (status.textContent = `The scene runs in: ${value}`),
});

document.body.append(room.el, status);
```

## React API

`Select` (types in `dist/react/text-inputs.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createSelect`: a styled native select.

```ts
export function Select({ label, helper, error, success, labelStyle, options, placeholder, size, required, disabled, className, value, defaultValue, ...rest }: SelectProps);

export interface SelectProps extends FieldParts, Omit<SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement>, 'size'> {
  options: readonly SelectItem[];
  /** A first, empty choice shown until one is picked. */
  placeholder?: string;
  size?: InputSize;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Select } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function SelectExample() {
  const [room, setRoom] = useState('');
  return (
    <Select
      label="Room"
      placeholder="Choose a room"
      helper={room ? undefined : 'The scene runs in this room.'}
      options={[
        { value: 'living', label: 'Living room' },
        { value: 'kitchen', label: 'Kitchen' },
        { value: 'bedroom', label: 'Bedroom' },
        { value: 'garage', label: 'Garage', disabled: true },
      ]}
      value={room}
      onChange={(event) => setRoom(event.target.value)}
    />
  );
}
```
